73901.meaning2: fact of existing; fact of occurrence

73904.commentary: (ANt) avijahitā hontī'ti tāsaṃ bhāvanāya brahmānaṃ brahmaloke uppannattā avijahitā honti bhāvanā.

examples.text: brahmā'ti mātāpitaro'ti seṭṭh'ādhivacanaṃ. yathā brahmuno catasso bhāvanā avijahitā honti mettā karuṇā muditā upekkhā'ti, evam'eva mātāpitūnaṃ puttakesu catasso bhāvanā avijahitā honti.

73905.meaning1: they call stability of mind with immediate results
73905.commentary: (KPa) samādhim'ānantarikaññam'āhū'ti yañ'ca attano pavattisamanantaraṃ niyamen'eva phalapadānato ānantarikasamādhī'ti āhu. na hi maggasamādhimhi uppanne tassa phal'uppattinisedhako koci antarāyo atthi. (VISMa) samādhim'ānantarikaññam'āhū'ti yaṃ attano pavattisamanantaraṃ niyamen'eva phalappadānato ānantarikasamādhī'ti āhū'ti attho. anantaram'eva pavattanakaṃ phalaṃ anantaraṃ, tattha niyutto, taṃ vā payojanaṃ etassā'ti ānantariko, maggo.

examples.text: yaṃ buddhaseṭṭho parivaṇṇayī suciṃ, samādhim'ānantarikañ'ñam'āhu, samādhinā tena samo na vijjati, idam'pi dhamme ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu

73906.meaning1: which he attained; which he experienced

examples.text: khayaṃ virāgaṃ amataṃ paṇītaṃ, yad'ajjhagā sakyamunī samāhito, na tena dhammena sam'atthi kiñci, idam'pi dhamme ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.
na dīgham'āyuṃ labhate dhanena, na c'āpi vittena jaraṃ vihanti. appaṃ h'idaṃ jīvitam'āhu dhīrā, asassataṃ vippariṇāmadhammaṃ.

73908.meaning1: of this it would be good if; his perhaps; of this hopefully

examples.text: app'evanām'imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā'ti

73909.meaning1: like a town; similar to a city
73909.commentary: (DHPa) nagar'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ ṭhapetvā'ti nagaraṃ nāma bahiddhā thiraṃ hoti, gambhīraparikhaṃ pākāraparikkhittaṃ dvāraṭṭālakayuttaṃ, anto-suvibhatta-vīthi-catukka-siṅghāṭaka-sampannaṃ antar'āpaṇaṃ, taṃ vilumpissāmā'ti bahiddhā corā āgantvā pavisituṃ asakkontā pabbataṃ āsajja paṭihatā viya gacchanti, evam'eva paṇḍito kulaputto attano vipassanācittaṃ thiraṃ nagarasadisaṃ katvā ṭhapetvā nagare ṭhito ekatodhār'ādi-nānappakārā-vudhena coragaṇaṃ viya vipassanāmayena ca ariyamaggamayena ca paññ'āvudhena taṃtaṃmaggavajjhaṃ kilesamāraṃ paṭibāhanto taṃ taṃ kilesamāraṃ yodhetha, pahareyyāthā'ti attho.

examples.text: kumbh'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, nagar'ūpamaṃ cittam'idaṃ ṭhapetvā, yodhetha māraṃ paññ'āvudhena, jitañ'ca rakkhe anivesano siyā.

73910.commentary: (SNPa) vibhūsā eva vibhūsanaṭṭhānaṃ. (VINt) gandhavasena chavirāgavasena ca sādiyanaṃ vibhūsanaṃ.

examples.text: mālā-gandha-vilepana-dhāraṇa-maṇḍana-vibhūsanaṭṭhānā veramaṇī-sikkhāpadaṃ samādiyāmi.

73911.commentary: (VINt) jātarūpa-rajata-paṭiggahaṇā'ti ettha jātarūpan'ti suvaṇṇaṃ. rajatan'ti kahāpaṇo lohamāsako jatumāsako dārumāsako'ti ye vohāraṃ gacchanti, tassa ubhayassa'pi paṭiggahaṇaṃ jātarūparajatapaṭiggahaṇaṃ.

examples.text: jātarūpa-rajata-paṭiggahaṇā veramaṇī-sikkhāpadaṃ samādiyāmi.
antaṃ antaguṇaṃ udariyaṃ karīsaṃ matthaluṅgaṃ [( ) sabbattha n'atthi, aṭṭhakathā ca dvattiṃsasaṅkhyā ca manasi kātabbā]

73913.meaning1: planted in the ground; rooted in the earth

examples.text: yath'indakhīlo paṭhavissito siyā, catubbhi vātehi asampakampiyo, tath'ūpamaṃ sappurisaṃ vadāmi, yo ariyasaccāni avecca passati, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

73914.meaning1: attainment of vision; success in seeing; epithets of stream entry
73914.commentary: (KHPa) dassanasampadāyā'ti sotāpattimaggasampattiyā. sot'āpattimaggo hi nibbānaṃ disvā kattabbakiccasampadāya sabbapaṭhamaṃ nibbānadassanato dassanan'ti vuccati, tassa attani pātubhāvo dassanasampadā, tāya dassanasampadāya saha eva.

examples.text: sahā'v'assa dassanasampadāya, tayassu dhammā jahitā bhavanti, sakkāyadiṭṭhī vicikicchitañ'ca, sīlabbataṃ vā'pi yadatthi kiñci.

73915.meaning1: beyond the wall; behind the wall

examples.text: tirokuṭṭesu tiṭṭhanti, sandhisiṅghāṭakesu ca, dvārabāhāsu tiṭṭhanti, āgantvāna sakaṃ gharaṃ.

73916.meaning1: intersection; junction; crossroads; (comm) four-way and three-way intersections
73916.commentary: (KHPa) sandhisiṅghāṭakesu cā'ti ettha sandhiyo'ti catukkoṇaracchā vuccanti gharasandhi-bhittisandhi-ālokasandhiyo c'āpi. siṅghāṭakā'ti tikoṇaracchā vuccanti, tadekajjhaṃ katvā purimena saddhiṃ saṅghaṭento sandhisiṅghāṭakesu cā'ti āha.

examples.text: tirokuṭṭesu tiṭṭhanti, sandhisiṅghāṭakesu ca, dvārabāhāsu tiṭṭhanti, āgantvāna sakaṃ gharaṃ.

73917.meaning1: having arrived; having come to; having returned
73917.commentary: (KHPa) āgantvāna sakaṃ gharan'ti ettha sakaṃ gharaṃ nāma pubbañātigharam'pi attanā sāmikabhāvena ajjhāvutthapubbagharam'pi. tadubhayam'pi yasmā te sakagharasaññāya āgacchan'ti, tasmā āgantvāna sakaṃ gharan'ti āha.

examples.text: tirokuṭṭesu tiṭṭhanti, sandhisiṅghāṭakesu ca, dvārabāhāsu tiṭṭhanti, āgantvāna sakaṃ gharaṃ.

73918.meaning1: due to deeds; because of (one's) actions
73918.commentary: (KHPa) kammapaccayā, attanā katassa adāna-dāna-ppaṭisedhan'ādi-bhedassa kadariyakammassa paccayā. tañ'hi tesaṃ kammaṃ ñātīnaṃ sarituṃ na deti.

examples.text: pahūte annapānamhi, khajjabhojje upaṭṭhite, na tesaṃ koci sarati, sattānaṃ kammapaccayā.

73919.meaning1: buying and renting; (comm) buying and selling
73919.commentary: (KHPa) hiraññena kay'ākayan'ti hiraññena kayavikkayam'pi tattha tādisaṃ n'atthi, yaṃ tesaṃ sampattipaṭilābhahetu bhaveyya.

examples.text: na hi tattha kasi atthi, gorakkhettha na vijjati, vaṇijjā tādisī n'atthi, hiraññena kay'okayaṃ, ito dinnena yāpenti, petā kālaṅ'katā tahiṃ.
na hi tattha kasi atthi, gorakkhettha na vijjati, vaṇijjā tādisī n'atthi, hiraññena kay'okayaṃ, ito dinnena yāpenti, petā kālaṅ'katā tahiṃ.

73921.meaning1: well stored; carefully stashed; well deposited
73921.commentary: (KHPa) tass'attho, so nidhi tāva sunihito santo, tāva suṭṭhu nikhaṇitvā ṭhapito samāno'ti vuttaṃ hoti. (KHPa) tattha pubbapadena taṃ dān'ādīhi sunihitanidhiṃ niddisati eso nidhi sunihito'ti.

examples.text: tāva sunihito santo, gambhīre odak'antike, na sabbo sabbadā eva, tassa taṃ upakappati.

73922.commentary: (KHPa) saññā vā assa vimuyhati, yasmiṃ ṭhāne nihito nidhi, taṃ na jānāti

examples.text: nidhi vā ṭhānā cavati, saññā v'āssa vimuyhati, nāgā vā apanāmenti, yakkhā vā'pi haranti naṃ.

73923.meaning1: giving all objects of desire; providing all sensual pleasures (to)
73923.commentary: (JAa) sabbakāmadadan'ti sabbe vatthukāme dātuṃ samatthaṃ kumbhaṃ. (JAa) ke paṇḍite sabbakāmadade'ti ko etesu gandhabb'ādīsu paṇḍito sabbakāmaṃ dātuṃ samattho, so vidhurassa hadayamaṃsadohaḷiniyā mama mātu manorathaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā mayhaṃ dīgharattaṃ bhattā bhavissatī'ti.

examples.text: esa devamanussānaṃ, sabbakāmadado nidhi, yaṃ yadev'ābhipatthenti, sabbam'etena labbhati.
kim'attham'abhisandhāya, lahucittassa dubbhino, sabbakāmadadass'eva, imaṃ dukkhaṃ titikkhasi.

73924.meaning1: fact of having a good voice; having a beautiful tone
73924.commentary: (KHPa) susaratā nāma brahmassaratā karavīkabhāṇitā, sā'pi etena labbhati.

examples.text: suvaṇṇatā susaratā, susaṇṭhānā surūpatā, ādhipaccaparivāro, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73925.meaning1: fact of having a voice; fact of having a tone
73925.commentary: (KHPa) susaratā nāma brahmassaratā karavīkabhāṇitā, sā'pi etena labbhati.

73926.meaning1: fact of having a voice like god

73927.meaning1: fact of speaking with a clear and melodious voice

73928.meaning1: fact of talking; fact of sounding (like)
73928.commentary: (NIDD1a) anuppiyabhāṇitā'ti paccayavasena punappunaṃ piyavacanabhaṇanā. (VISM) anuppiyabhāṇitā'ti sacc'ānurūpaṃ dhamm'ānurūpaṃ vā anapaloketvā punappunaṃ piyabhaṇanam'eva.

73929.commentary: (KHPa) surūpatā'ti ettha sakalasarīraṃ rūpan'ti veditabbaṃ ākāso parivārito rūpaṃtv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī'ti-ādīsu viya, tassa rūpassa sundaratā surūpatā n'ātidīghatā n'ātirassatā n'ātikisatā n'ātithūlatā n'ātikāḷatā naccodātatā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: suvaṇṇatā susaratā, susaṇṭhānā surūpatā, ādhipaccaparivāro, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73930.meaning1: fact of not being too tall
73930.construction:
na + ati + dīgha + tā
nātidīgha + tā

73931.grammar: fem, abstr, from na atirassa, neg
73931.meaning1: fact of not being too short
73931.construction:
na + ati + rassa + tā
nātirassa + tā

examples.text: musāvādā veramaṇiyā vippasannindriyatā vissaṭṭhamadhurabhāṇitā samasitasuddhadantatā n'ātithūlatā n'ātikisatā n'ātirassatā n'ātidīghatā sukhasamphassatā uppalagandhamukhatā sussūsakaparijanatā ādeyyavacanatā kamaluppalasadisamudulohitatanujivhatā anuddhatatā acapalatāti evam'ādīni.

73932.grammar: fem, abstr, comp, from na atikisa, neg
73932.meaning1: fact of not being too thin; fact of not being too skinny
73932.construction:
na + ati + kisa + tā
nātikisa + tā
73932.commentary: (SNt) n'ātikisā'ti ativiya kisathaddhamaṃsalohitā dissamānā aṭṭhisarīrā jālasarīrā na hoti.

73933.grammar: fem, abstr, comp, from na atithūla, neg
73933.meaning1: fact of not being too fat
73933.construction:
na + ati + thūla + tā
nātithūla + tā

73934.grammar: fem, abstr, from na atikāḷa, neg
73934.meaning1: fact of not being too dark; fact of not being too black-skinned
73934.construction:
na + ati + kāḷa + tā
nātikāḷa + tā
73934.commentary: (SNt) n'ātikāḷā n'āccodātā'ti ativiya kāḷavaṇṇā jhām'aṅgāro viya, dadhitakk'ādīhi pamajjitamattakaṃsalohavaṇṇā na hoti.

73935.grammar: fem, abstr, comp, from na accodāta, neg
73935.meaning1: fact of not being too white; fact of not being too light-skinned
73935.construction:
na + ati > aty > acc + odāta + tā
nāccodāta + tā
73935.commentary: (SNt) n'ātikāḷā n'āccodātā'ti ativiya kāḷavaṇṇā jhām'aṅgāro viya, dadhitakk'ādīhi pamajjitamattakaṃsalohavaṇṇā na hoti.

73936.meaning1: fact of being well shaped and having good looks
73936.meaningLit: good standing together good form state
73936.commentary: (KHPa) susaṇṭhānā'ti suṭṭhu saṇṭhānatā, samacitavaṭṭitayuttaṭṭhānesu aṅgapaccaṅgānaṃ samacitavaṭṭitabhāvena sanniveso'ti vuttaṃ hoti. sā'pi etena labbhati. (KHPa) surūpatā'ti ettha sakalasarīraṃ rūpan'ti veditabbaṃ ākāso parivārito rūpaṃtv'eva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī'ti-ādīsu viya, tassa rūpassa sundaratā surūpatā n'ātidīghatā n'ātirassatā n'ātikisatā n'ātithūlatā n'ātikāḷatā naccodātatā'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: suvaṇṇatā susaratā, susaṇṭhānasurūpatā, ādhipaccaparivāro, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73937.meaning1: rulership and retinue; leadership and (having a) following
73937.commentary: (KHPa) parivāro'ti agārikānaṃ sajanaparijanasampatti, anagārikānaṃ parisasampatti, ādhipaccañ'ca parivāro ca ādhipaccaparivāro.

examples.text: suvaṇṇatā susaratā, susaṇṭhānā surūpatā, ādhipaccaparivāro, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73938.meaning1: ease of an emperor; comfort of monarch
73938.commentary: (KHPa) cakkavattisukhaṃ piyan'ti iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ manāpaṃ cakkavattisukhaṃ. iminā cāturantacakkavattirajjaṃ dasseti.

examples.text: padesarajjaṃ issariyaṃ, cakkavattisukhaṃ piyaṃ, devarajjam'pi dibbesu, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73939.meaning1: human; in the world of men
73939.commentary: (KHPa) tass'āyaṃ padavaṇṇanā, manussānaṃ ayan'ti mānussī, mānussī eva mānussikā. sampajjanaṃ sampatti.

examples.text: mānussikā ca sampatti, devaloke ca yā rati, yā ca nibbānasampatti, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73940.meaning1: due to the attainment of a (spiritual) friend; because of gaining a (good) companion
73940.commentary: (KHPa) sampajjati etāya guṇavibhūtiṃ pāpuṇātī'ti sampadā, mitto eva sampadā mittasampadā, taṃ mittasampadaṃ. āgammā'ti nissāya.

examples.text: mittasampadam'āgamma, yoniso'va payuñjato, vijjā vimutti vasībhāvo, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73941.meaning1: acquiring a (spiritual) friend; gaining a (good) companion
73941.commentary: (KHPa) sampajjati etāya guṇavibhūtiṃ pāpuṇātī'ti sampadā, mitto eva sampadā mittasampadā, taṃ mittasampadaṃ.

examples.text: mittasampadam'āgamma, yoniso'va payuñjato, vijjā vimutti vasībhāvo, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73942.commentary: (KHPa) payuñjato'ti yog'ānuṭṭhānaṃ karoto. (VVt) payuñjato'ti tattha pakārena yuñjantassa, taṃ aññesaṃ vācentassa vā.

examples.text: mittasampadam'āgamma, yoniso'va payuñjato, vijjā vimutti vasībhāvo, sabbam'etena labbhati.

73943.commentary: (PMa) sāvakapāramippatto'ti ettha mahāpaññānaṃ aggassa mahāsāvakassa sattasaṭṭhiyā sāvakañāṇānaṃ pāragamanaṃ pāramī, sāvakassa pāramī sāvakapāramī, taṃ sāvakapāramiṃ patto'ti sāvakapāramippatto. sāvakapāramitāppatto'ti vā pāṭho.

examples.text: paṭisambhidā vimokkhā ca, yā ca sāvakapāramī, paccekabodhi buddhabhūmi, sabbam'etena labbhati.

dve puggalā paṭisambhidappattā, dve'pi pubbayogasampannā, dve'pi bahussutā, dve'pi desanābahulā, dve'pi gar'ūpanissitā, dve'pi vihārabahulā, dve'pi paccavekkhaṇābahulā, dve'pi asekhapaṭisambhidappattā, eko sāvakapāramippatto, eko na sāvakapāramippatto.
paṭisambhidā vimokkhā ca, yā ca sāvakapāramī, paccekabodhi buddhabhūmi, sabbam'etena labbhati.
ten'eva saṃvegamukhena dhīrā, vinā'pi buddhehi sutikkhapaññā, ārammaṇenā'pi parittakena, paccekabodhiṃ anupāpuṇanti.

73945.commentary: (VINa) mah'atthiko'ti mahāupakāro. (KHPa) mahanto attho assā'ti mah'atthikā, mahato atthāya saṃvattatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti, mah'iddhikā'ti'pi pāṭho.

examples.text: evaṃ mah'atthikā esā, yadidaṃ puññasampadā, tasmā dhīrā pasaṃsanti, paṇḍitā katapuññatan'ti.

73946.meaning1: making merit; accomplishment of good deeds

examples.text: evaṃ mah'atthikā esā, yadidaṃ puññasampadā, tasmā dhīrā pasaṃsanti, paṇḍitā katapuññatan'ti.

73947.grammar: masc, comp, loc sg of sabbaloka, irreg form of sabbalokasmiṃ
73947.construction:
sabba + loka + asmiṃ > asmi
sabbaloka + asmi
73947.commentary: (KHPa) evaṃ sabb'ākārena mettābhāvanaṃ dassetvā idāni tass'eva vaḍḍhanaṃ dassento āha mettañ'ca sabbalokasmī'ti. (KHPa) mittassa bhāvo mettaṃ. sabbalokasmī'ti anavasese sattaloke.

examples.text: mettañ'ca sabbalokasmi, mānasaṃ bhāvaye aparimāṇaṃ, uddhaṃ adho ca tiriyañ'ca, asambādhaṃ averam'asapattaṃ.
tiṭṭhaṃ caraṃ nisinno va, sayāno yāvatāssa vitamiddho, etaṃ satiṃ adhiṭṭheyya, brahmam'etaṃ vihāram'idha'm'āhu.

73949.commentary: (KHPa) vijānāti etāyā'ti vijjā, vimuccati etāya, sayaṃ vā vimuccatī'ti vimutti, vijjā ca vimutti ca vijjāvimuttiyo, vijjāvimuttīsu vasībhāvo vijjāvimuttivasībhāvo.

73950.commentary: (KHPa) kālagatā'ti attano maraṇakālena gatā, kālakatā'ti vā pāṭho, katakālā katamaraṇā'ti attho.

73951.meaning1: precept to abstain (from); training rule to not

73952.meaning1: precept to abstain (from); training rule to not

73953.meaning1: suffering follows; discomfort comes after; trouble trails
73953.commentary: (DHPa) tato naṃ dukkham'anvetī'ti tato tividhaduccaritato taṃ puggalaṃ dukkhaṃ anveti, duccarit'ānubhāvena catūsu apāyesu, manussesu vā tam'attabhāvaṃ gacchantaṃ kāyavatthukam'pi itarampī'ti iminā pariyāyena kāyikacetasikaṃ vipākadukkhaṃ anugacchati.

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce paduṭṭhena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ dukkham'anveti, cakkaṃ'va vahato padaṃ.

73954.meaning1: ease comes after; happiness results; pleasure follows
73954.commentary: (PTP) tato naṃ sukham'anvetī'ti somanassam'api naṃ anveti yaṃ susukhacchāyā tadā'pi naṃ sukhaṃ tadapi anveti.

examples.text: manopubbaṅ'gamā dhammā, manoseṭṭhā manomayā, manasā ce pasannena, bhāsati vā karoti vā, tato naṃ sukham'anveti, chāyā'va anapāyinī.

73955.meaning1: ranging in wrong notions; in the field of incorrect concepts
73955.commentary: (DHPa) te sāran'ti te pana taṃ micchādiṭṭhiggahaṇaṃ gahetvā ṭhitā kāmavitakk'ādīnaṃ vasena micchāsaṅkappagocarā hutvā sīlasāraṃ, samādhisāraṃ, paññāsāraṃ, vimuttisāraṃ, vimuttiñāṇadassanasāraṃ, param'atthasāraṃ, nibbānañ'ca n'ādhigacchanti.

examples.text: asāre sāramatino, sāre c'āsāradassino, te sāraṃ n'ādhigacchanti, micchāsaṅkappagocarā.

73956.meaning1: ranging in right notions; in the field of correct concepts
73956.commentary: (DHPa) te sāran'ti te paṇḍitā evaṃ sammādassanaṃ gahetvā ṭhitā nekkhammasaṅkapp'ādīnaṃ vasena sammāsaṅkappagocarā hutvā taṃ vuttappakāraṃ sāraṃ adhigacchantī'ti.

examples.text: sārañ'ca sārato ñatvā, asārañ'ca asārato, te sāraṃ adhigacchanti, sammāsaṅkappagocarā.
yathā agāraṃ suchannaṃ, vuṭṭhī na samativijjhati, evaṃ subhāvitaṃ cittaṃ, rāgo na samativijjhati.

73958.meaning1: ascending the palace of understanding; climbing the tower of wisdom

examples.text: pamādaṃ appamādena, yadā nudati paṇḍito, paññāpāsādam'āruyha, asoko sokiniṃ pajaṃ, pabbataṭṭho'va bhūmaṭṭhe, dhīro bāle avekkhati.

73959.commentary: (DHPa) abalassaṃvā'ti kuṇṭhapādaṃ chinnajavaṃ dubbalassaṃ sīghajavo sindhavājānīyo viya.

examples.text: appamatto pamattesu, suttesu bahujāgaro, abal'assaṃ'va sīgh'asso, hitvā yāti sumedhaso.
appamatto pamattesu, suttesu bahujāgaro, abal'assaṃ'va sīgh'asso, hitvā yāti sumedhaso.

73961.meaning1: hard to protect; difficult to guard
73961.commentary: (DHPa) dūrakkhan'ti kiṭṭhasambādhe ṭhāne kiṭṭhakhādakagoṇaṃ viya ek'ekasmiṃ sappāy'ārammaṇe'y'eva duṭṭhapanato dūrakkhaṃ.

examples.text: phandanaṃ capalaṃ cittaṃ, durakkhaṃ dunnivārayaṃ, ujuṃ karoti medhāvī, usukāro'va tejanaṃ.

73962.meaning1: landing where it likes; alighting wherever it wants
73962.commentary: (DHPa) tassa dunniggahassa lahuno. yatthakāmanipātino'ti yattha katthaci'd'eva nipatanasīlassa. etañ'hi labhitabbaṭṭhānaṃ vā alabhitabbaṭṭhānaṃ vā yuttaṭṭhānaṃ vā ayuttaṭṭhānaṃ vā na jānāti, n'eva jātiṃ oloketi, na gottaṃ, na vayaṃ. yattha yattha icchati, tattha tatth'eva nipatatī'ti yatthakāmanipātī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: dunniggahassa lahuno, yatthakāmanipātino, cittassa damatho sādhu, cittaṃ dantaṃ sukh'āvahaṃ.

73963.commentary: (DHPa) uppattikāle ek'ekam'eva cittaṃ uppajjati, tasmiṃ niruddhe puna ek'ekam'eva uppajjatī'ti ekacaraṃ nāma jātaṃ.

examples.text: dūraṅ'gamaṃ ekacāraṃ, asarīraṃ guh'āsayaṃ, ye cittaṃ saṃyamessanti, mokkhanti mārabandhanā.

73964.meaning1: who has an unstable mind; who is mentally ungrounded
73964.commentary: (DHPa) anavaṭṭhitacittassā'ti cittaṃ nām'etaṃ kassaci nibaddhaṃ vā thāvaraṃ vā n'atthi. yo pana puggalo assapiṭṭhe ṭhapitakumbhaṇḍaṃ viya ca thusarāsimhi koṭṭitakhāṇuko viya ca khallāṭasīse ṭhapitakadambapupphaṃ viya ca na katthaci saṇṭhāti, kadāci buddhasāvako hoti, kadāci ājīvako, kadāci nigaṇṭho, kadāci tāpaso. evarūpo puggalo anavaṭṭhitacitto nāma. tassa anavaṭṭhitacittassa. (JAa) anavaṭṭhitacittassā'ti appatiṭṭhitacittassa.

examples.text: anavaṭṭhitacittassa, saddhammaṃ avijānato, pariplavapasādassa, paññā na paripūrati.

73965.meaning1: whose faith fluctuates; who has wavering conviction
73965.commentary: (DHPa) saddhammaṃ avijānato'ti sattatiṃsa-bodhipakkhiyadhamma-bhedaṃ imaṃ saddhammaṃ avijānantassa parittasaddhatāya vā uplavasaddhatāya vā pariplavapasādassa kām'āvacara-rūp'āvacar'ādi-bhedā paññā na paripūrati.

examples.text: anavaṭṭhitacittassa, saddhammaṃ avijānato, pariplavapasādassa, paññā na paripūrati.

73966.meaning1: whose mind is not oozing (with lust); who is not mentally sodden

examples.text: anavassutacittassa, ananvāhatacetaso, puññapāpapahīnassa, n'atthi jāgarato bhayaṃ.

73967.meaning1: who has abandoned good and evil; who has transcended merit and wrongdoing
73967.commentary: (DHPa) puññapāpapahīnassā'ti catutthamaggena pahīnapuññassa c'eva pahīnapāpassa ca khīṇ'āsavassa.

examples.text: anavassutacittassa, ananvāhatacetaso, puññapāpapahīnassa, n'atthi jāgarato bhayaṃ.
ko imaṃ pathaviṃ vijessati, yamalokañ'ca imaṃ sadevakaṃ, ko dhammapadaṃ sudesitaṃ, kusalo puppham'iva pacessati.

73969.commentary: (DHPa) pheṇ'ūpaman'ti imaṃ kes'ādisamūhasaṅkhātaṃ kāyaṃ abaladubbal'aṭṭhena anaddhaniyatāvakālik'aṭṭhena pheṇapiṇḍasarikkhako'ti viditvā.

examples.text: pheṇ'ūpamaṃ kāyam'imaṃ viditvā, marīcidhammaṃ abhisambudhāno, chetvāna mārassa papupphakāni, adassanaṃ maccurājassa gacche.

73970.grammar: prp of na pothayati, neg, trans (+acc)

examples.text: yathā'pi bhamaro pupphaṃ, vaṇṇagandhamapoṭhayaṃ, paleti rasam'ādāya, evaṃ gāme munī care.
yathā'pi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ, vaṇṇavantaṃ sagandhakaṃ, evaṃ subhāsitā vācā, saphalā hoti kubbato.
appamatto ayaṃ gandho, yv'āyaṃ tagaracandanaṃ, yo ca sīlavataṃ gandho, vāti devesu uttamo.
yathā saṅkāradhānasmiṃ, ujjhitasmiṃ mahāpathe, padumaṃ tattha jāyetha, sucigandhaṃ manoramaṃ.

73974.meaning1: imagining wise; thinking (oneself to be) intelligent
73974.commentary: (JAa) paṇḍitamānī'ti yo sayaṃ bālo hutvā ahaṃ paṇḍito'ti attānaṃ maññamāno paṇḍitānaṃ ovādaṃ akatvā sakassa cittassa vasaṃ gacchati, so sacittassa vasaṃ gantvā yath'āyaṃ dubbacaka'pi matasayanaṃ sayito, evaṃ sayethā'ti attho.

examples.text: yo bālo maññati bālyaṃ, paṇḍito vā'pi tena so, bālo ca paṇḍitamānī, sa ve bālo'ti vuccati.

73975.meaning1: sweet tasting; as sweet as honey
73975.commentary: (DHPa) madhuvā'ti bālassa hi pāpaṃ akusalakammaṃ karontassa taṃ kammaṃ madhu viya madhurarasaṃ viya iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ manāpaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti. iti naṃ so madhuṃ'va maññati.

examples.text: madhuvā maññati bālo, yāva pāpaṃ na paccati, yadā ca paccati pāpaṃ, bālo dukkhaṃ nigacchati.

73976.meaning1: householders and monastics; laypeople and renunciants

examples.text: mam'eva kata maññantu, gihīpabbajitā ubho, mam'ev'ātivasā assu, kicc'ākiccesu kismici, iti bālassa saṅkappo, icchā māno ca vaḍḍhati.

73977.meaning1: reason for material gain; cause for worldly acquisition
73977.commentary: (DHPa) aññā hi lābh'ūpanisā, aññā nibbānagāminī'ti lābh'ūpanisā nām'esā aññā eva, aññā nibbānagāminī paṭipadā. lābh'uppādakena hi bhikkhunā thokaṃ akusalakammaṃ kātuṃ vaṭṭati, kāyavaṅk'ādīni kātabbāni honti. yasmiñ'hi kāle kāyavaṅk'ādīsu kiñci karoti, tadā lābho uppajjati. pāyasapātiyañ'hi vaṅkaṃ akatvā ujukam'eva hatthaṃ otāretvā ukkhipantassa hattho makkhitamattako'va hoti, vaṅkaṃ katvā otāretvā ukkhipantassa pana pāyasapiṇḍaṃ uddharanto'va nikkhamati, evaṃ kāyavaṅk'ādīni karaṇakāle'y'eva lābho uppajjati.

examples.text: aññā hi lābh'ūpanisā, aññā nibbānagāminī, evam'etaṃ abhiññāya, bhikkhu buddhassa sāvako, sakkāraṃ n'ābhinandeyya, vivekam'anubrūhaye.

73978.meaning1: like Inda's column; similar to the gate post of a city
73978.commentary: (DHPa) so ime maṃ catūhi paccayehi sakkaronti, ime pana na sakkarontī'ti sakkārañ'ca asakkārañ'ca karontesu n'eva anurujjhati, no virujjhati, atha kho pathavisamo ca indakhil'upamo eva ca hoti.

examples.text: pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhil'upamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.

73979.meaning1: like Inda's column; similar to the gate post of a city

examples.text: pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhīl'ūpamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.
pathavisamo no virujjhati, indakhil'upamo tādi subbato, rahado'va apetakaddamo, saṃsārā na bhavanti tādino.

73981.meaning1: concerned with verses which are unbeneficial; unrelated to profitable poems

examples.text: yo ca gāthā sataṃ bhāse, anatthapadasañhitaṃ, ekaṃ dhammapadaṃ seyyo, yaṃ sutvā upasammati.

73982.meaning1: ultimate winner in war; supreme victor in battle
73982.commentary: (DHPa) sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo'ti so saṅgāmajinānaṃ uttamo pavaro saṅgāmasīsayodho'ti.

examples.text: yo sahassaṃ sahassena, saṅgāme mānuse jine, ekañ'ca jeyya'm'attānaṃ, sa ve saṅgāmaj'uttamo.

73983.meaning1: paying respect to the elderly; honouring the seniors; venerating the venerable
73983.commentary: (DHPa) vuḍḍh'āpacāyino'ti gihissa vā tadahupabbajite daharasāmaṇere'pi, pabbajitassa vā pana pabbajjāya vā upasampadāya vā vuḍḍhatare guṇavuḍḍhe apacāyamānassa, abhivādanena vā niccaṃ pūjentassā'ti attho.

examples.text: abhivādanasīlissa, niccaṃ vaddh'āpacāyino, cattāro dhammā vaḍḍhanti, āyu vaṇṇo sukhaṃ balaṃ.
yo ca vassasataṃ jīve, kusīto hīnavīriyo, ek'āhaṃ jīvitaṃ seyyo, vīriyam'ārabhato daḷhaṃ.

73985.meaning1: where standing; where staying; where remaining

examples.text: na antalikkhe na samuddamajjhe, na pabbatānaṃ vivaraṃ pavissa, na vijjatī so jagatippadeso, yatraṭṭhito mucceyya pāpakammā.

73986.commentary: (UDa) attano sukham'esāno, pecca so na labhate sukhan'ti so puggalo attano sukhaṃ esanto gavesanto patthento pecca paraloke manussasukhaṃ dibbasukhaṃ nibbānasukhanti tividham'pi sukhaṃ na labhati, añña'd'atthu tena daṇḍena dukkham'eva labhatī'ti attho.

examples.text: sukhakāmāni bhūtāni, yo daṇḍena vihiṃsati, attano sukham'esāno, pecca so na labhate sukhaṃ.

73988.meaning1: will give up; will abandon; will let go (of)

examples.text: asso yathā bhadro kasāniviṭṭho, ātāpino saṃvegino bhavātha, saddhāya sīlena ca vīriyena ca, samādhinā dhammavinicchayena ca, sampannavijjācaraṇā patissatā, pahassatha dukkham'idaṃ anappakaṃ.

73989.meaning1: abode of disease; nest of illness
73989.commentary: (DHPa) tañ'ca kho sabbarogānaṃ nivāsaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena roganīḷaṃ, (ITIa) akkhirog'ādīnaṃ anekesaṃ rogānaṃ nīḷaṃ kulāvakan'ti roganīḷaṃ.

examples.text: parijiṇṇam'idaṃ rūpaṃ, roganiḍḍhaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ, bhijjati pūtisandeho, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ.

73990.commentary: (DHPa) tañ'ca kho sabbarogānaṃ nivāsaṭṭhān'aṭṭhena roganīḷaṃ, (ITIa) akkhirog'ādīnaṃ anekesaṃ rogānaṃ nīḷaṃ kulāvakan'ti roganīḷaṃ.

examples.text: parijiṇṇam'idaṃ rūpaṃ, roganiḍḍhaṃ pabhaṅguraṃ, bhijjati pūtisandeho, maraṇ'antañ'hi jīvitaṃ.

73991.meaning1: smeared with flesh and blood; coated with meat and blood

examples.text: aṭṭhīnaṃ nagaraṃ kataṃ, maṃsalohitalepanaṃ, yattha jarā ca maccu ca, māno makkho ca ohito.

73992.meaning1: transmigration through many births; cyclical existence having multiple rebirths
73992.commentary: (THa) anekajātisaṃsāran'ti anekajātisatasahassasaṅkhyaṃ idaṃ saṃsāravaṭṭaṃ, addhuno adhippetattā accantasaṃyogekavacanaṃ.

examples.text: anekajātisaṃsāraṃ, sandhāvissaṃ anibbisaṃ, gahakāraṃ gavesanto, dukkhā jāti punappunaṃ.

73993.meaning1: intent on one's own benefit; interested in personal welfare
73993.commentary: (DHPa) evarūpañ'hi atta'd'attham'abhiññāya ayaṃ me attano attho'ti sallakkhetvā, sadatthapasuto siyā'ti tasmiṃ sake atthe uyyuttapayutto bhaveyyā'ti.

examples.text: atta'd'atthaṃ par'atthena, bahunā'pi na hāpaye, atta'd'attham'abhiññāya, sadatthapasuto siyā.

73994.meaning1: like a royal carriage; like the king's coach

examples.text: etha passath'imaṃ lokaṃ, cittaṃ rājarath'ūpamaṃ, yattha bālā visīdanti, n'atthi saṅgo vijānataṃ.

73995.meaning1: freed from the net; escaped from the snare
73995.commentary: (DHPa) jālamutto'vā'ti yathā chekena sākuṇikena jālena ottharitvā gayhamānesu vaṭṭakesu koci'd'eva jālato muccati. sesā antojālam'eva pavisanti. tathā maraṇajālena otthaṭesu sattesu bahū apāyagāmino honti

examples.text: andhabhūto ayaṃ loko, tanuk'ettha vipassati, sakuṇo jālamutto'va, appo saggāya gacchati.

73996.meaning1: who has overcome (concern for) the next world; who has rejected (interest in) the afterlife
73996.commentary: (DHPa) vitiṇṇaparalokassā'ti vissaṭṭhaparalokassa. evarūpo hi manussasampattiṃ devasampattiṃ avasāne nibbānasampattin'ti imā tisso'pi sampattiyo na passati.

examples.text: ekaṃ dhammaṃ atītassa, musāvādissa jantuno, vitiṇṇaparalokassa, n'atthi pāpaṃ akāriyaṃ.

73997.meaning1: having infinite range; of boundless domain

examples.text: yassa jitaṃ n'āvajīyati, jitaṃ yassa no yā'ti koci loke, taṃ buddham'anantagocaraṃ, apadaṃ kena padena nessatha.

73998.meaning1: purifying one's own mind; cleaning one's heart; (comm) removing the five hindrances
73998.commentary: (DHPa) sacittapariyodapanan'ti pañcahi nīvaraṇehi attano cittassa vodāpanaṃ. (VISMa) sakaṃ cittaṃ sacittaṃ, sacittassa sabbaso kilesānaṃ samucchindanena visodhanaṃ sacittapariyodāpanaṃ. evaṃ pana paññākicce matthakappatte uttari karaṇīyābhāvato sāsanassa paññ'uttaratā veditabbā.

examples.text: sabbapāpassa akaraṇaṃ, kusalassa upasampadā, sacittapariyodāpanaṃ, etaṃ buddhāna sāsanaṃ.

73999.commentary: (DHPa) kahāpaṇavassenā'ti yaṃ so apphoṭetvā sattaratanavassaṃ vassāpesi, taṃ idha kahāpaṇavassan'ti vuttaṃ. tena'pi hi vatthukāmakilesakāmesu titti nāma n'atthi. evaṃ duppūrā esā taṇhā.

examples.text: na kahāpaṇavassena, titti kāmesu vijjati, app'assādā dukhā kāmā, iti viññāya paṇḍito.
